editorial:
Imagine you are a struggling writer who is tired of failing while everyone else wins. That is exactly where you find Albin. While working in Germany, he meets Andreas, a guy who has everything: fame, money, and a beautiful wife named Helene. Albin does not just want to be like Andreas; he wants to replace him entirely. The vibe is tense and awkward, making you feel the desperation as Albin tries to sneak into Helene's heart while her husband is away. It is a slow-burn game of cat and mouse where you are never quite sure who is playing whom.

What really works here is the acting. You can see the jealousy and greed on Albin's face in every scene. While the pace is a bit slow for some, the tension builds up in a way that keeps you guessing. If you love stories about obsession and people trying to steal lives, you will love this.
endingExplained: The story wraps up when Albin's plan to steal Andreas's life falls apart. After trying to manipulate Helene and push Andreas out of the picture, the truth comes out. Instead of winning the girl and the fame, Albin ends up losing everything. He realizes that he cannot simply swap places with another person. The movie ends with a cold feeling, showing that greed and jealousy usually lead to a lonely, empty finish.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological games and old-school European thrillers.
